name: Things
description: Things is a personal task manager from Cultured Code that organizes to-dos into projects and areas, with a focus on elegant design and simplicity for planning daily and long-term work on Apple devices.
best_for: Positioned for individuals on Apple devices who want a single, elegantly designed app for organizing personal tasks, projects, and life areas without a subscription.
features: Projects for organizing related tasks and Areas for grouping ongoing responsibilities
Today and Upcoming views for daily and future planning
Reminders and calendar integration for scheduling
Markdown support in project and task notes
Keyboard shortcuts for fast entry and navigation

alternatives.name: Todoist
alternatives.description: A cross-platform task manager with natural-language scheduling, projects, and collaboration features.
alternatives.best_for: Users who want a task manager available on Android, Windows, Linux, and web

alternatives.name: TickTick
alternatives.description: A to-do list and calendar app with habit tracking, Pomodoro timers, and multiple planning views.
alternatives.best_for: Users who want task management combined with habit tracking and time-blocking
